title: Haphazard Error Nesting (Nominal Case Buried Deep)
pattern: Deep nesting structures where nominal success logic is buried at the deepest level, and error recovery/returns are deferred to trailing `else` clauses.
why_bad: The "happy path" is obscured. The reader must wade through multiple layers of conditions and mentally stack them to understand the success flow.
detection: Nominal success logic nested deeper than error check branches, with error logic postponed to outer-scope `else` blocks.
counterexample: Deep nesting required for complex algorithmic branching where both paths are equally likely nominal flows.
